# clio auth token add

Generate a network credential, print its secret exactly once, and store only the digest in the owner-only token store; the secret cannot be recovered

## Usage

```
clio auth token add --label LABEL --actor ACTOR --bank BANK [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

generates a credential, prints its secret exactly once, and stores only the digest in the owner-only token store; the secret cannot be recovered — save it when you see it; the store file is held under a lock for the whole write, so a run that cannot take the lock refuses without printing a secret, and --db and --backend are refused because they cannot change what is written

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--label LABEL` | text |  | Names the credential record that `auth_cli` adds or revokes; it is the record's identity. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the actor the credential acts as; `auth_cli::run_add` stores it in the token record. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the credential to one bank; the parser keeps every occurrence and `auth_cli::run_add` stores them all in the record. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Mint a credential and save the secret when it prints.
```
clio auth token add --label laptop --actor user --bank default
```

Scope one credential to two banks.
```
clio auth token add --label ci --actor harness --bank default --bank work
```

Print the one-time secret and its record as JSON.
```
clio auth token add --label agent-01 --actor agent --bank default -o json
```
